topic: Festival gratuito reúne Emicida, Ebony, Don L e KL Jay em celebração à cultura preta e periférica no DF Revista Raça Brasil
insights: The Festival Elemento em Movimento is a free event taking place in Ceilândia, DF, from September 2 to 6, 2026.
The festival features over 30 attractions, including prominent artists like Emicida, Ebony, Don L, and KL Jay.
The event aims to celebrate black and peripheral culture through music, workshops, and community engagement.
This year's festival will introduce three stages: Palco Elemento, Palco Baile, and Palco Sesc Underground.
The festival is part of a broader initiative to promote urban culture and strengthen community ties.

quotes.text: The festival celebrates the culture urbana como espaço de encontro, cuidado coletivo, ancestralidade e fortalecimento comunitário.

summary: The Festival Elemento em Movimento is set to take place in Ceilândia, DF, from September 2 to 6, 2026, featuring a diverse lineup of over 30 artists. It aims to celebrate and promote black and peripheral culture through various performances and workshops, fostering community engagement.
